mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY manager_type_cd, tdm08_org_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") AS manager_info_id , manager_type_cd AS manager_type , manager_type_nm AS manager_type_name , tdm08_org_id AS org_id , tdm08_org_nm AS org_name , tdm08_person_id AS person_id , tdm08_person_nm AS person_name FROM ( SELECT manager_type_cd , manager_type_nm , tdm08_org_id , f_org_nm(tdm08_org_id, f_today()) tdm08_org_nm , tdm08_person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm08_person_id) tdm08_person_nm FROM ( SELECT sys09_code manager_type_cd , sys09_name manager_type_nm FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'TdmManagerType' AND sys09_company_id = 0 AND sys09_code LIKE '1%' AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'2000-01-01') >= f_today() ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') != 'true' ) ) ) sys LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tdm08_manager_type , tdm08_person_id , f_get_empTrans(tdm08_person_id, f_today(), 'org_code_id')::numeric tdm08_org_id FROM tdm08_manager_info WHERE tdm08_company_id = #{companyId} AND f_today() BETWEEN tdm08_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm08_end_date,'9999-12-31'::date) ) tdm08 ON tdm08_manager_type = manager_type_cd UNION ALL SELECT manager_type_cd , manager_type_nm , org_id , org_nm , tdm08_person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm08_person_id) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT tdm23_org_id org_id , org00_kor_nm org_nm , sys.* FROM tdm20_role INNER JOIN tdm23_role_relate_org ON tdm23_role_id = tdm20_role_id INNER JOIN getOrg(#{companyId}, f_today()) ON org00_org_id = tdm23_org_id CROSS JOIN ( SELECT sys09_code manager_type_cd , sys09_name manager_type_nm FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'TdmManagerType' AND sys09_company_id = 0 AND sys09_code LIKE '2%' AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'2000-01-01') >= f_today() ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') != 'true' ) ) ) sys WHERE tdm20_company_id = #{companyId} AND f_today() BETWEEN tdm20_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm20_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) ) org LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tdm08_manager_type , tdm08_org_id , tdm08_person_id FROM tdm08_manager_info WHERE tdm08_company_id = #{companyId} AND f_today() BETWEEN tdm08_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm08_end_date,'9999-12-31'::date) ) tdm08 ON ( tdm08_manager_type = manager_type_cd AND tdm08_org_id = org_id ) ) t WHERE CONCAT(tdm08_org_nm, tdm08_person_nm) ILIKE #{searchText}

SELECT tdm08_manager_info_id AS manager_info_id , tdm08_manager_type AS manager_type , tdm08_org_id AS org_id , tdm08_person_id AS person_id , tdm08_start_date AS start_date , tdm08_end_date AS end_date , emp00_kor_nm AS person_name , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp00_pos_cd, tdm08_company_id, tdm08_start_date) AS pos_name , emp00_org_code_nm AS org_name FROM tdm08_manager_info INNER JOIN LATERAL getPerson(#{companyId}, tdm08_start_date) ON emp00_person_id = tdm08_person_id WHERE tdm08_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm08_manager_type = #{managerType} AND ( ( tdm08_manager_type LIKE '2%' AND tdm08_org_id = #{orgId} ) OR ( tdm08_manager_type LIKE '1%' ) ) ORDER BY tdm08_start_date DESC

SELECT tdm08_manager_info_id AS manager_info_id , tdm08_manager_type AS manager_type , tdm08_org_id AS org_id , tdm08_person_id AS person_id , tdm08_start_date AS start_date , tdm08_end_date AS end_date , emp00_kor_nm AS person_name , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp00_pos_cd, tdm08_company_id, tdm08_start_date) AS pos_name , emp00_org_code_nm AS org_name FROM tdm08_manager_info INNER JOIN LATERAL getperson(tdm08_company_id, tdm08_start_date) ON emp00_person_id = tdm08_person_id WHERE tdm08_manager_info_id = #{managerInfoId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm08_manager_info ( tdm08_manager_info_id, tdm08_company_id, tdm08_manager_type, tdm08_org_id, tdm08_person_id, tdm08_start_date, tdm08_end_date, tdm08_upd_nm, tdm08_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{managerInfoId}, #{companyId}, #{row.managerType}, #{row.orgId}, #{row.personId}, #{row.startDate}, #{row.endDate}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
